Title: On the question of Ghoul retainers.

Messages.Author: Vince Johnson
Messages.Body:
I have a torie with a ghoul retainer and a .44. My Torie opts not to use
the gun for the first strike and let's the retainer take it. My Torie
strikes with hands and then adds 2 strikes via a blur. Can the torie take
the gun back to use for those 2 actions?

Vince

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


Yes.

Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
In article <78sve9$ok2@simba>, Vince Johnson <john...@tcnj.edu> writes

>My Torie
>strikes with hands and then adds 2 strikes via a blur. Can the torie take
>the gun back to use for those 2 actions?

The concept of the Toreador having to take the gun back is what is
stopping you seeing this. The Ghoul Retainer merely uses it. It is
never transferred to him. The Toreador still has the gun.
